title: Storm Sorceress Over Fleet
description: A dark-haired sorceress in flowing robes stands on a stormy cliff edge, holding a glowing staff in one hand while casting a swirling vortex of light and wind with the other. Below her, a turbulent sea with massive waves engulfs several wooden sailing ships, while behind her rises a majestic fantasy castle under a dark, lightning-filled sky with swirling clouds and a glowing dragon-like spirit.
prompt: A powerful dark-haired sorceress in ornate flowing robes stands on a rocky cliff above a violent stormy ocean, holding a glowing magical staff in one hand and casting a swirling vortex of light and wind with the other, several old wooden sailing ships are being tossed by massive crashing waves below, behind her a majestic fantasy ice castle with glowing spires rises into a dark turbulent sky filled with lightning and swirling clouds, ethereal dragon spirit formed of wind and light, dramatic fantasy scene
